when: Compact destination-link navigation using native auto popover and CSS anchors
behavior: Native popovertarget/auto popover; no page script on supported platforms
invariants: Half resolved margin between trigger and panel
Open state does not resize surrounding layout
Escape closes and returns focus; outside click closes
Panel radius uses the same resolved control-radius expression as its trigger, including corner factor and scale; never card radius
limits: Replace example fragment destinations with valid routes
Requires native auto popover, CSS anchor position-area/fallbacks and logical positioning; browser verification is recorded separately
No focus trap or arrow-key application-menu semantics
Navigation to a same-document fragment does not necessarily dismiss the panel; Escape/outside click remain native dismissal
Verified browser baseline: Chromium 151, Firefox 153, WebKit 26.5; older browsers are not promised a scripted fallback.

construction.panel: nav.menu__content[popover=auto] with matching id and position-anchor
construction.icons: Authored local Phosphor SVGs in geometry slots
construction.repetition: Unique panel IDs and CSS anchor names for each instance; retain explicit trigger/panel pairing in expanded indicator CSS
construction.application: Valid navigation destinations; no arrow-key command-menu semantics

customization.constraint: Inside the anchor-support rule, the percentage height cap resolves against available placement space. Do not replace it with a viewport-height cap. Large content panels keep an explicit Close action visible while the body scrolls. Retain the named full-inline above/below fallbacks: side-flip placement can fail because the panel is wider than either inline area. Content popovers reserve their scrolling row instead of imposing a fixed whole-panel minimum.
customization.verification: Open, expand, reopen and scroll at viewport edges; measure panel containment separately from document overflow.

implementation.anatomy: Use the exact trigger/panel and unique pairing in construction.
implementation.native: behavior owns opening/dismissal; limits distinguish destination navigation from ARIA command-menu behavior.
implementation.javascript: None for opening, placement or dismissal on the verified native baseline. Application destinations remain consumer-owned.
implementation.fallback: No legacy placement shim is supplied. Outside the stated native baseline, provide ordinary visible destination links or a separately owned and verified fallback; do not imply native support from markup alone.

evidence.scope: Authored native recipe and keyboard/script-disabled paths on these engine versions; older engines, installed Safari and assistive technology are unverified.

slotGeometry.label: data-slot=label; flexible text column, normal wrapping, no icon dimensions
slotGeometry.indicator: data-slot=indicator; token icon dimensions; bundled Phosphor caret
slotGeometry.verification: Long labels fit the trigger at narrow widths; indicator and subsequent content do not overlap.
